title: Ollama v0.40.3 released today with server guard fixes
summary: Ollama v0.40.3 published Oct 11 (Shanghai time) fixes server duplicate/downgrade guard warnings; llama.cpp shipped b11552 yesterday with three consecutive builds.
body:
Ollama v0.40.3 published Oct 11 (Shanghai time) fixes server duplicate/downgrade guard warnings; llama.cpp shipped b11552 yesterday with three consecutive builds.

GitHub 与基建

- llama.cpp b11552 released yesterday — Oct 10: three builds in a row. b11549 adds slot-save-path env var, b11548 fixes mtmd speculative decoding.
